Smoke test: load wdl and parse a simple snippet

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"wdl\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("version 1.0\n", config)
    println(result)
}
```
